dz: 二战:日本帝国海军在"醒岛"战役中首次遭受地表舰艇损失.
de: World War II: The Imperial Japanese Navy suffers its first loss of surface vessels during the Battle of Wake Island.

t: 在珍珠港被袭击后美国人向日本帝国宣战后,德国和意大利向美国宣战. 而美国则对他们宣战.
te: Germany and Italy declare war on the United States, following the Americans' declaration of war on the Empire of Japan …
dz: 二战:在珍珠港被袭击后美国人向日本帝国宣战后,德国和意大利向美国宣战. 而美国则对他们宣战.
de: World War II: Germany and Italy declare war on the United States, following the Americans' declaration of war on the Empire of Japan in the wake of the attack on Pearl Harbor. The United States, in turn, declares war on them.

dz: 二战:54名日本A6M 零战斗机袭击了菲律宾的巴坦加斯战地. Jesús Villamor和4名菲律宾战斗机飞行员挡住他们;César Basa被杀死.
de: World War II: Fifty-four Japanese A6M Zero fighters raid Batangas Field, Philippines. Jesús Villamor and four Filipino fighter pilots fend them off; César Basa is killed.

t: 阿道夫·希特勒在帝国总理府的一次会议上宣布即将灭绝犹太人。
te: Adolf Hitler declares the imminent extermination of the Jews at a meeting in the Reich Chancellery.
dz: 大屠杀：阿道夫·希特勒在帝国总理府的一次会议上宣布即将灭绝犹太人。
de: The Holocaust: Adolf Hitler declares the imminent extermination of the Jews at a meeting in the Reich Chancellery.

t: 德国军队在哈尔科夫市东南部的峡谷 Drobytsky Yar 屠杀了 15,000 多名犹太人。
te: German troops murder over 15,000 Jews at Drobytsky Yar, a ravine southeast of the city of Kharkiv.
dz: 乌克兰大屠杀：德国军队在哈尔科夫市东南部的峡谷 Drobytsky Yar 屠杀了 15,000 多名犹太人。
de: The Holocaust in Ukraine: German troops murder over 15,000 Jews at Drobytsky Yar, a ravine southeast of the city of Kharkiv.

dz: 二战:阿道夫·希特勒任命自己为"海雷斯"(Oberkommando des Heeres)的首领.

dz: 二战:意大利潜水员所布设的Limpet地雷在亚历山大港严重损坏了HMS Valiant和Elizabeth女王号.
de: World War II: Limpet mines placed by Italian divers heavily damage HMS Valiant and HMS Queen Elizabeth in Alexandria harbour.

de: World War II: A Thai-Japanese Pact of Alliance is signed.

dz: 二战:经过15天的战斗后,日本帝国陆军占领了醒岛.

dz: 二战:克钦被日军所征服.

dz: 12月17日被任命为美国太平洋舰队司令的切斯特·W·尼米茨上将抵达珍珠港.

de: Admiral Émile Muselier seizes the archipelago of Saint Pierre and Miquelon, which become the first part of France to be liberated by the Free French Forces.

dz: 二战:香港战役结束,开始日本占领香港.

de: U.S. President Franklin D. Roosevelt signs a bill establishing the fourth Thursday in November as Thanksgiving Day in the United States.
